We're sorry for the rate limits and unnecessary quota consumption on the K3.1 Pro subscription plan. These were our issues, and we should have fixed them sooner.

Today, every subscriber on every plan gets a one-time usage reset, restoring 25% of their monthly quota (usage below 25% resets to zero), equal to one week of usage. Your usage bar will reflect this adjustment by end of day PST.

We've also adjusted the plan's parameters and are reducing unnecessary subagent calls and output length, so your quota goes further.

Thank you for your patience while we put this right.

It takes a crew to land a moonshot. Join the Kimi Ambassador Program.

Anyone who's turned an untested idea into reality knows: moonshots are never a solo mission. It takes a crew.

The Kimi Global Ambassador Program finds likeminded individuals on the same path, bringing the crew together. We hope that you:

🌙 Are influential in your own community, whether it be in tech, entrepreneurship, content creation, or on campus
🌙 Have implemented Kimi K3 into products, agents, workflows, teams, and communities
🌙 Are willing to share your experiences and passions to a broader community

We are releasing PerceptionBench, a benchmark that isolates visual perception and evaluates it as a set of atomic capabilities - discovered from how today's models fail, rather than defined in advance. 

From frontier-model failures across 42 benchmarks, we derive 10 atomic perceptual capabilities and construct 3,000 verified questions, each isolating a single capability and answerable by looking, with no reasoning or external knowledge required.
